Summaries.eng: The animation  "Ling Tian Du Zun" is adapted from the web novel of the same name by Qimao's contracted writer You Mu. Ling Tian, a sword saint of his generation, went against the will of heaven to seize the stele in order to save his beloved, but was plotted against by the way of heaven. When he fell, he perished together with the way of heaven, but was unexpectedly reborn, returning to the moment of his death three hundred years ago when his dantian was completely destroyed and his sword bone was taken away. His beauty is still there, his old enemy is still there, and he has been on the long road to becoming a saint, so why not start over? In this life, he vows to rewrite his destiny and make up for his regrets!

Summaries.zho: 一代剑圣凌天，为救挚爱之人逆天夺碑，却遭天道算计。陨落之际，他与天道同归于尽，竟意外重生，回到三百年前丹田尽毁、剑骨被夺的濒死时刻。红颜未逝，宿敌犹在，漫漫成圣路，重走又何妨？这一世，他誓要改写天命，弥补遗憾！
Summaries.zhtw: 一代劍聖凌天，為救摯愛之人逆天奪碑，卻遭天道算計。隕落之際，他與天道同歸於盡，竟意外重生，回到三百年前丹田盡毀、劍骨被奪的瀕死時刻。紅顏未逝，宿敵猶在，漫漫成聖路，重走又何妨？這一世，他誓要改寫天命，彌補遺憾！

Summaries.eng: In Episode 08 of Ling Tian Du Zun (凌天独尊), Ling Tian delves deeper into the Cultivation Pavilion, facing rising challenges and uncovering hidden truths that could alter his fate forever. Get a sneak peek at this next intense test on his path to supremacy!

The battle grows fiercer as Ling Tian faces unprecedented danger! Will he overcome the combined might of his enemies and take another step toward the throne of supremacy? Don’t miss the next thrilling episode of Ling Tian Du Zun!

As the aftermath of the fierce battle with Mu King Guards settles, new threats loom. With destiny pulling strings behind the scenes, can the protagonist rise to the challenge, or will he fall under the weight of betrayal and ambition?
